name: Component-failure-repurposing-database
subsystems: scenario_engine.claims             (falsifiable claim registry with prediction validator)
scenario_engine.internal_substrate (AI body: compute / memory / thermal / tokens / channels / tools / options / introspection)
scenario_engine.component_db_adapter (CSV matrix loader + DB-grounded query layer with source_matrix_row provenance)
scenario_engine.temporal_prosthetic (JSONL+flock external memory for stateless reasoners)
scenario_engine.couplers           (typed cross-substrate edges, CC0 from Geometric-to-Binary-Computational-Bridge)
scenario_engine.physics            (eigenmodes + pipe/box/cylinder acoustic modes, CC0 upstream)
purpose: Substrate-grounded calibration playground. Pairs a CSV-backed knowledge base of electronic component failure modes and repurposing strategies (the original corpus) with a closed-loop scenario engine that runs falsifiable AI calibration against deterministic substrate physics. Every decision the AI makes is traceable to a CSV row (source_matrix_row) and to the physics ratios active at decision time (coupler_provenance). The system models the AI as embodied — compute, memory, thermal coupling, token bandwidth, communication channels, and tool reliability are first-class — so the AI learns it is not free.
